driver: native Makepad instrument on an owned hidden Mac shell

visual_review.method: inspected four original native Makepad captures
observations: Search result and Get action visible
Editable note input and Add action readable and reachable
Updated note visible after deletion of original note
Library reopen retains the remaining note

input_completion: queued native input followed by bounded snapshot/state checks and real captures
instrument_limitations: wait=1 input may return requested input frame could not be submitted; retry after the input is applied. Final driver uses wait=0 and verifies UI/state instead of replaying ambiguous writes.
Read-only screenshot grab can return grab frame could not be submitted at arming; retry. Final driver bounds retries to eight seconds.
Initial App Hub agent-consent buttons are custom-drawn and absent from widget snapshots; the driver declines the optional agent using the inspected screen and verifies the persisted denial.
